meta.method: starplast.calibration: skill = (observed - chance)/(1 - chance); tuned setting chosen on seeds 1-3, reported on seeds 4-5; 95% CI by two-stage bootstrap over targets then runs

attention_correction.metric: share of the top 22 corrected pairs sharing a pb_transferred_phenotype label

blind_battery.metric: share of first-half findings that replicate on the second half

block_ablation.metric: hidden accuracy of the evidence ranked first (expr)

cluster_guilt.metric: precision of calls on hidden genes

condition_shift.metric: rank correlation of predicted and hidden values

consensus_modules.metric: F1 of hidden genes in the module chosen for their label on known genes

geneset_hunt.metric: F1 of the hidden members against the best cluster's other genes

holdout_search.metric: F1 of hidden genes in the cluster chosen for their label on known genes

label_outliers.metric: AUROC of surprise for the swapped labels

link_prediction.metric: AUROC of hidden pairs against degree-matched non-pairs

masked_imputation.metric: median per-column rank correlation on hidden entries

multiplex_modules.metric: F1 of hidden genes in the community chosen for their label on known genes

neighbour_space.metric: AUROC of hidden coexpression edges against degree-matched non-pairs

network_training.metric: AUROC of hidden coexpression edges against degree-matched non-pairs

ortholog_transfer.metric: rank correlation of transferred and hidden values

paralog_divergence.metric: AUROC of profile divergence for paralogs with different pb_transferred_phenotype

positive_unlabeled.metric: AUROC of hidden members against every other gene

recoverability_atlas.metric: hidden-gene AUROC of the categories the atlas ranks in its top half

seed_expansion.metric: AUROC of hidden members against every other gene

set_enrichment.metric: AUROC of hidden members against every other gene

trait_regression.metric: rank correlation of predicted and hidden values

triangulation.metric: precision of calls on hidden genes
